result.Method of Attack: Stealthily harvesting sensitive information including crypto wallet details, MongoDB connection strings, and environment variables; exfiltrating data via Better Stack logging service; selective targeting of wallets with balances over 1,000 units; cron-style persistence using pm2
result.Impacted Systems: Developer systems using npm packages, crypto wallets, MongoDB-connected applications
result.Attack Vector: Masquerading as a legitimate revival of CryptoJS library; deceptive brand-mimicking open source component
result.Indicators of Compromise: Link to Better Stack logging service (formerly Logtail); nearly 1,928 downloads
